shellCommands.command:
mkdir -p data && echo "[]" > data/books.json && PORT=3001 node server.js &
sleep 1.5
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ | head -n 200
echo "--- INDEX STATUS ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:3001/
echo
curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/books
echo
echo "--- ADD BOOK ---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3001/api/books -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"The Hobbit","author":"J.R.R. Tolkien","notes":"Great adventure"}'
echo
cat data/books.json
echo "--- GET DETAIL ---"
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8'))[0].id)")
echo "ID=$ID"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/books/$ID | head -n 100
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3001/books/$ID/finish | head
curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/books | head
echo "--- CHECK RESTART PERSISTENCE (kill and restart) ---"
pkill -f "PORT=3001" ; sleep 1
PORT=3001 node server.js & sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/books
cat data/books.json
pkill -f "node server.js" || kill %1; sleep 1; ps aux | grep server
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ | head -n 20 || echo "server stopped as expected"

sleep 1; curl -s http://localhost:3001/api/books | head
cat data/books.json
jobs
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 0.5; echo "killed"
ps aux | grep -v grep | grep server || echo "no server"
curl -s http://localhost:3001/ 2>&1 | head -n 5 || echo "server down ok"

pkill -f "node server.js" 2>&1; sleep 0.5
echo "[]" > data/books.json
PORT=3000 node server.js &
sleep 1
echo "=== INDEX ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "Currently Reading|Finished|My Books"
echo "=== ADD via form (urlencoded) ==="
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" --data "title=Dune&author=Frank+Herbert&notes=Spice+must+flow" | head -n 20
sleep 0.2
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "Dune|Frank Herbert|Currently Reading \(1\)"
cat data/books.json
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8'))[0].id)")
echo "ID=$ID"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -E "Dune|Frank Herbert|Spice|Shareable link"
echo "=== MARK FINISHED ==="
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish | head -n 10
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "Currently Reading \(0\)|Finished \(1\)"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -E "Finished|Dune"
echo "=== API ==="
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books | head
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books/$ID | head
echo "=== JSON sharing ==="
curl -s -H "Accept: application/json" http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | head
echo "=== 404 ==="
curl -s -i http://localhost:3000/books/notexist | head -n 5
# kill and restart to test persistence
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 0.5
PORT=3000 node server.js & sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books | head
echo "=== RESET CLEAN ==="
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 0.5
echo "[]" > data/books.json
cat data/books.json
echo "tests done"
ps aux | grep server | grep -v grep || echo "no server running"

jobs
ps aux | grep node
cat data/books.json
sleep 1
PORT=3000 node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E "Currently Reading|Finished"
echo "STARTED"
pkill -f "node server.js"; sleep 0.5; echo "killed"
ps aux | grep node || echo "none"

pkill -f "server.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5
ps aux | grep server || echo "clean"
echo "[]" > data/books.json
cat data/books.json
PORT=3000 node server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
echo $!
sleep 1
cat /tmp/server.log
curl -s http://localhost:3000/health
echo " health ok"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "Currently Reading (0)"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "title=Dune&author=Frank+Herbert&notes=Spice+must+flow" -v 2>&1 | head -20
sleep 0.2
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "Dune"
cat data/books.json
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8'))[0].id)")
echo "ID $ID"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -o "Shareable link"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish -v 2>&1 | head -20
sleep 0.2
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o "Finished (1)"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | grep -o "Finished"
pkill -f "server.js"; sleep 0.5
echo "restart..."
PORT=3000 node server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books | grep -o "Dune"
echo "persist ok"
pkill -f "server.js"; sleep 0.5
echo "[]" > data/books.json
echo "final reset"
cat data/books.json

ps aux | head -20
cat /tmp/server.log 2>&1
echo "try directly"
timeout 3 bash -c 'PORT=3000 node server.js &' ; sleep 2; curl -s http://localhost:3000/health || echo "no health"
ps aux | grep node

curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | head -n 80
echo "---ADD---"
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"Test Book","author":"Test Author","notes":"my notes here"}'
echo
cat data/books.json
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json','utf8'))[0].id)")
curl -s http://localhost:3000/books/$ID | head -n 40
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{}'
echo "after finish"
cat data/books.json
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books
echo "--- restart test ---"
kill 472
sleep 1
PORT=3000 node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books
kill %1; sleep 1
echo "[]" > data/books.json
cat data/books.json
ps aux | grep server | grep -v grep || echo "cleaned"

ls -R -a | head -100
cat server.js | wc -l
cat package.json
cat data/books.json
ls -la data/

ps aux | grep node; pkill -9 -f server.js 2>&1; sleep 0.5; ps aux | grep node | grep -v run.mjs | grep -v opencode || echo "servers killed"
echo "[]" > data/books.json
ls -la

ls -la
cat data/books.json
ps aux | grep -i server || echo "no server"
echo done

echo "[]" > data/books.json && echo "[]" > books.json && cat books.json && node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/books -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"title":"Persist Check","author":"A","notes":"n"}'
echo
cat data/books.json | head
cat books.json | head
pkill -f server.js; sleep 0.5
PORT=3000 node server.js &
sleep 1
curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/books
pkill -f server.js; sleep 0.5
echo "[]" > data/books.json; echo "[]" > books.json
cat data/books.json; cat books.json
echo "done"

pkill -f server.js 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5; echo "[]" > data/books.json; echo "[]" > books.json; ls -la *.json data/*.json; cat data/books.json; cat books.json; ps aux | grep node | grep -v run.mjs | grep -v opencode || echo "clean"
ls -la; cat data/books.json; cat books.json 2>&1; ps aux | head -20

echo "[]" > data/books.json
echo "[]" > books.json
cat data/books.json
ls -la data/ books.json
